appearance_facts.fact: The state labeled KS is filled with a very dark maroon color, which matches the bottom of the color scale.
The state labeled IL is filled with a pale yellow color, which matches the top of the color scale.
The state labeled DE is filled with a dark red color, similar to states like NC or KY.
The state labeled ND is filled with the same very dark maroon color as KS.
The state labeled NC is filled with the same very dark maroon color as KS and ND.

printed_facts.fact: Title: 'Risk Index of Hazard H in US States'
Color scale labeled 'High' at the top (100) and 'Low' at the bottom (0).
The scale transitions from pale yellow (High/100) through orange and red to dark maroon (Low/0).
KS is labeled in the center of the Kansas shape.
IL is labeled in the center of the Illinois shape.
DE is labeled in the center of the Delaware shape.
